comment.comment:
Didn’t have time to post my own thesis earlier so quoted Doug’s masterpiece, but here it is. Not sellin’ 😤

The fundamental story here has not changed. The market is simply moving in response to tremendous macro uncertainty, justified or not.

So since everything is moving together (downward), you have to look at relative strength. The reality is:

1. Every time BTC shows any signs of relief, STONK pumps.

2. Every time STONK pumps, KNOTS has consistently been one of Top 5 strongest coins off the bottom in the STONK eco. It’s STONK beta, pure and simple.

3. Todays selloff was driven by a top holder yeeting their entire meme portfolio. This doesn’t speak fundamentally to KNOTS, and we’ve already recovered the dip.

Despite the legions of absolute pansy automatons freaking out over “Black Monday” on Twitter right now, it is nonetheless the start of a new 4yr cycle for Bitcoin. The world keeps spinning, the FUD will pass, crypto will run, and KNOTS remains one of the fastest horses.

If you’re a clear eyed thinker who forms their own theses, you’re comfy here. Don’t let the traders and overly vocal small time holders running around X get you all worked up. The investors across crypto are holding strong. They understand this is a long game, and huge amounts of uncertainty when you’re this far out on the risk curve is just part of how this works.

Good times ahead 👊
